intro: Pets Eden is searching for dedicated and passionate individuals who love animals as much as we do. For those that thrive in a work environment that revolves around the care of our furry friends, being a part of our dynamic team is a start to an extremely rewarding career. No experience is needed for the traineeship below — your training is paid for by a sponsoring salon, and a full-time job is waiting at the end of it.

jobs.title: Groomer in Training — Fully Sponsored, Job Guaranteed
jobs.intro: Learn professional dog, cat or rabbit grooming without paying a cent in course fees. A sponsoring salon covers your course and pays you an allowance while you train, then takes you on as a full-time groomer on full salary once you qualify. You meet the sponsor and they meet you before either side commits.
duties: Apply below — tell us a bit about yourself and which animal you'd like to train with.
First interview with Pets Eden, so we can get to know you.
Second interview with the sponsoring salon — your future employer.
If both sides are happy: class every day for 3 months, fees and allowance paid by the sponsor.
You then start work at the sponsor's salon as a full-time groomer, on full salary.
requirements: A genuine liking for animals and the patience to handle them gently.
No grooming experience needed — we teach you from the ground up.
Able to attend class every day for the full 3 months.
Willing to commit to a 2-year bond with the sponsoring salon after you qualify.
extra: There are no course fees for you to pay — the sponsor pays them.
The exact allowance, salary and bond terms are agreed between you and the sponsor during the process.
You can train in dog, cat or rabbit grooming; tell us which when you apply.

footnote: Applying for the traineeship? Use the form below. For anything else, email your resume, portfolio and asking salary to charlwong@gmail.com.
